Telangana CM Announces Aid for Statehood Activists' Families

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has announced financial aid for the families of statehood activists. The Chief Minister's Relief Fund (CMRF) will be utilized for this purpose. The aid is intended to support these families.
